records.title: Quantamination: Dynamic Quantization Leaks Your Data Across the Batch
records.reason: Quantamination exploits shared batch min/max scales in per-tensor dynamic activation quantization; experiments report 99.6–100% LLM token recovery in studied settings. Per-token quantization avoids the side channel and can be faster. This is a security analysis of an existing serving optimization, not an inference-improvement method.
